Note: this is not good for looking at the total spent + remaining.   This 
only looks at the schedule.   The EVMS plot does it different: it starts from
the current spent fund and adds the remaining work in the schedule to that.
I would need to add the CPR summary info into here like the monthly report does
to improve it.   It is is good for year-by-year view.

```{r}

all <- get.all.schedule(sched.name)
all <- apply.baseline.schedule(all, sched.base)
charges <- get.all.kronos()
people <- get.p6.people(charges, all)
tasks.people <- combine.tasks.people(people, all)
labor <- bin.labor(tasks.people)
costs <- bin.expenses(all$all.data)

```

This is the section that deals with the carryover spending and also 
used to know when we run our of funds for all CR or budget cut.

```{r}

jbk.1 <- costs$target.by.week %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(week) %>%
  filter(week>=as.Date(filt.st)) %>%
  mutate(cumu.cost=cumsum(hsum))

jbk.2 <- costs$target.by.week.task %>% ungroup() %>% 
  filter(week>=as.Date(filt.st), hsum>0) %>%
  mutate(cumu.cost=cumsum(hsum)) %>%
  left_join(
    select(all$all.data, code, name, rsrc_type, status, target_start, 
           target_end, start, finish, total_cost, total_float, free_float,
           label, category, wbs, wbs_low, wbs_high
           ),by=join_by(code)) %>% 
  mutate(total_float=total_float/8, free_float=free_float/8)

#jbk.2 %>% mutate(cumu_tot=cumsum(total_cost)) %>% view()

jbk.3a <- labor$by.week.task %>% ungroup() %>% 
  filter(week>=as.Date(filt.st), hsum>0, week<=as.Date(filt.en)) %>% 
  left_join(
    select(all$all.data, task_id, code, name, rsrc_type, label, category, wbs, wbs_low, wbs_high),by=join_by(task_id)) %>% select(-task_id) %>% 
  mutate(cumu.hours=cumsum(hsum))

jbk.3b <- jbk.3a %>% arrange(label, category, week) %>%
  mutate(cumu.hours=cumsum(hsum)) %>% 
  group_by(category, label) %>% mutate(cumu.catlab=cumsum(hsum))

```

```{r}
write_xlsx(jbk.1, paste(base.path,"output/ISR_Spending",cs.version,".xlsx",sep=''))
write_xlsx(jbk.2, paste(base.path,"output/ISR_SpendingWithTask",cs.version,".xlsx",sep=''))
write_xlsx(list(AllHours=jbk.3a, SummedHours=jbk.3b),
           path=paste(base.path,"output/ISR_HoursWithTask",cs.version,".xlsx",sep='')
)
```

look at all the unstarted tasks

```{r}
all$all.data %>% 
  select(code, name, start, finish, rsrc_type, wbs,area, wbs_low, category, label) %>% 
  filter(area==0, start>as.Date("2025-01-01"), !str_detect(name, "ilestone")) %>% 
  arrange(wbs, start) %>% 
  view()
```
